title: Python Desktop Application Developer (Windows) – GST Software | 3–5 Yrs | Hyderabad
description: Company: Nylun Global Private Limited Product: GST Software, a GST compliance and business software (Windows desktop + SaaS) for businesses and CA firms Location: Hyderabad (work from office) Experience: 3–5 years Salary: ₹3,00,000 – ₹9,00,000 per annum (based on skills and experience) Employment type: Full-time, permanent About us Nylun Global Private Limited is building GST Software , a GST compliance and business software for businesses and Chartered Accountant firms across India. It is delivered as a Windows desktop application and a cloud SaaS platform , built on one shared, modern codebase. More products will follow, including audit and accounting software. We are looking for a developer who knows how to build fast, reliable, secure Windows desktop software that thousands of businesses can install and use every day, including on older computers. Who we are looking for We want a young, energetic, hands-on developer who is: hungry for an opportunity to prove themselves by building and launching a real product ambitious to grow with a fast-growing company and take on bigger responsibility passionate about performance and quality , someone who cares when software is slow or breaks passionate about technology and AI , always learning new tools and better ways of working an owner , who takes responsibility for results, not only tasks a team player , happy to guide interns and freshers Technology you will work with Desktop shell: Python with pywebview + Microsoft WebView2 Backend: Python, Flask and FastAPI, running locally inside the desktop app Frontend: JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS inside WebView2 Database: SQLite (desktop), PostgreSQL (cloud), SQLAlchemy Data processing: DuckDB / Polars for large data and reports Browser automation: Selenium / Playwright Packaging and updates: Nuitka / PyInstaller, Inno Setup / MSIX / Velopack, code signing Security: Windows DPAPI, encryption, signed licences, OTP Quality and monitoring: pytest, GitHub Actions, Sentry AI tools: Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar, used daily What you will build and own 1. Installation and updates Package the Python application as a proper Windows program. We prefer Nuitka (faster, harder to copy); PyInstaller is also acceptable. Build a professional installer (Inno Setup, MSIX or Velopack) that also sets up the WebView2 runtime. Code signing (EV certificate) so Windows SmartScreen and antivirus software trust the installer. Automatic updates with signed update files, safe rollback and minimal download size. Smooth installs on Windows 10 and 11, including PCs without admin rights where possible. 2. Performance on lakhs of invoices, including old PCs Fast startup (target under 3–4 seconds) and fast screens (under 1 second), even on 4 GB RAM Windows 10 PCs. SQLite tuning: WAL mode, proper indexes, full-text search, batched writes, efficient queries. Heavy reconciliation and reports using DuckDB or Polars instead of slow row-by-row processing. Virtualised data tables in the UI, so lakhs of rows display smoothly without freezing. Background jobs for imports, reconciliation, reports and portal tasks, so the screen never hangs. Fast Excel import and export (python-calamine, xlsxwriter) and fast PDF generation. Profiling with cProfile and py-spy, measuring before and after every optimisation. Correct layout on all screen sizes and Windows scaling levels (100%–200% DPI). 3. Reliability and support Crash reporting (Sentry), clear log files, and a “send diagnostics” option for customer support. Safe database upgrades between versions, with automatic backup and restore. Recovery from damaged or locked database files. Stable handling of multiple GSTINs and companies on one computer. 4. Security Safe storage of passwords and portal credentials using Windows DPAPI. Encryption of sensitive local data where needed (for example SQLCipher). Secure licensing: signed licences, protection against tampering, and safe offline grace periods. Secure login with email and SMS OTP (including DLT-registered SMS templates). Input validation, CSRF protection, rate limiting, and secure local server settings. 5. GST portal browser automation Reliable automation of portal workflows with Selenium or Playwright. Automatic browser-driver management, session handling, timeouts, retries and recovery. Quick fixes when the portal changes. Follow the rules strictly: the user logs in and enters captcha/OTP themselves, with no bypassing. 6. Licensing, payments and communication Licence server on secure HTTPS, with Google sign-in. Razorpay live payment integration with webhooks, invoices and refunds. Email (SMTP) for invoices, OTP and notifications; SMS OTP through a DLT-registered provider. 7. Testing and launch readiness Automated tests with pytest, plus end-to-end UI tests. A Windows test set: Windows 10 and 11, different screen sizes and DPI levels, low-RAM PCs. Install testing on clean virtual machines before every release. Dry runs of GST portal workflows before release. Supporting a closed beta with real users: collecting feedback, fixing issues fast, and improving step by step. 8. Shared codebase with the cloud platform Build screens in React and backend modules in FastAPI so the same code works in both the desktop app and the cloud SaaS. Work with the cloud team on shared data models and secure desktop–cloud sync. 9. Team and AI Use AI coding tools every day to build faster, with the judgement to check AI-generated code. Guide interns and freshers through code reviews and task planning. Desktop shell technology (for your understanding) Option Our view Python + WebView2 (pywebview) Our main approach: light, fast, works well on older PCs. Tauri (Rust shell with Python alongside) A good advanced option for the future: small installer and built-in updater. Rust knowledge is a plus. Must-have skills 3–5 years of hands-on software development experience. Has shipped a Python (or similar) Windows desktop application to real users , not only web apps. Packaging: PyInstaller or Nuitka; installers (Inno Setup/MSIX); code signing; auto-update . SQLite and performance: indexes, large data handling, profiling (cProfile, py-spy). Flask/FastAPI , plus JavaScript/React for screens inside WebView2, Electron or Tauri. Selenium or Playwright browser automation. Windows knowledge: DPAPI and credential storage, background/tray processes, DPI scaling, file permissions, Windows 10/11 differences. Automated testing (pytest) and Git. AI-first working: daily use of AI coding tools, with real examples. Good communication in English. Telugu or Hindi is a plus. Good to have DuckDB / Polars for fast data processing. Sentry or similar crash reporting. Velopack / MSIX / WinSparkle update systems. Tauri or Rust. SQLCipher or other local database encryption. Razorpay, SMS (DLT) and email integration. GST, accounting, tax or fintech software experience. PostgreSQL and cloud deployment basics. No GST knowledge? No problem. Our Chartered Accountants will train you. We value strong engineering skills, attitude and willingness to learn. What we are NOT looking for Someone with only web experience who has never shipped desktop software. Someone who ignores performance on slower computers. Someone looking only for a comfortable, routine job. Someone who copies AI-generated code without understanding or checking it. Why join Nylun Global Private Limited Build and launch a real Windows product used by businesses and CA firms across India. A real opportunity to prove yourself: you own the desktop experience, from installer to performance. Fast growth: a clear path to Senior Developer and Lead roles for people who perform. Modern stack: Python, WebView2, React, FastAPI, DuckDB, Playwright, Nuitka, AI tools. AI-first culture: work the way modern engineering teams work. Learning: learn GST and fintech from experienced Chartered Accountants. Work directly with the founders , not through layers of management. Competitive salary: ₹3–9 lakh per annum based on skills and experience, with performance-based growth. Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

About the Role We are looking for an early-career Application Security Engineer to help application teams adopt practical security controls and complete consistent, risk-based reviews. You will support application discovery, evidence collection, secure development activities, security testing and remediation follow-through under the guidance of experienced AppSec colleagues. This role is suited to someone with sound technical fundamentals, curiosity and disciplined follow-through who wants to grow broad AppSec capability while delivering useful outcomes from day one. Location: Hyderabad, India. This is an office-based position and is not available as a remote role. Key Duties and Responsibilities Support discovery of applications and APIs, gather ownership and technology information, and maintain classification data such as criticality, exposure and data sensitivity. Coordinate evidence requests, review existing security information for relevance and identify missing, stale or out-of-scope evidence for reviewer attention. Guide standard-risk applications through defined security review activities, track required actions and prepare concise evidence-based review summaries for senior approval. Execute repeatable application security review steps using approved playbooks and escalate complex design, testing or risk questions. Run and interpret SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, container, DAST and API scans where applicable; confirm context with development teams before creating actionable findings. Perform focused manual checks of web applications and APIs, including authentication, access control, input handling, error handling and obvious workflow abuse, within an approved scope. Triage potential findings, collect reproduction evidence, apply the severity methodology and obtain senior review for material or ambiguous issues. Track remediation commitments, review evidence and retest straightforward fixes; reopen or escalate where the weakness remains exploitable. Provide developers with approved secure-coding guidance, examples and links to standards; capture recurring questions for broader enablement. Assist threat-modelling workshops by documenting assets, data flows, trust boundaries, threats, assumptions and agreed actions. Maintain assessment notes, evidence links, decisions, metrics and governance records so another reviewer can understand what was tested and why. Support tool trials, regression checks and false-positive analysis, providing structured feedback on usability and detection quality. Engage constructively with application owners, engineers and control partners; communicate blockers early and keep actions moving. Knowledge, Skills and Experience Typically 2-4 years in cybersecurity, software engineering, quality engineering or IT risk, including at least one year of security-focused work or equivalent practical training. Foundational understanding of web technologies, HTTP, APIs, authentication, authorisation and common application vulnerabilities. Ability to read code or configuration in at least one language or technology stack and reason about insecure patterns.
